title_en: Mine post-disaster environment advanced detection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine post-disaster environment advanced detection robot which comprises key component modules such as an environment advanced detection module, a communication module, an information fusion module, a carrying module, a walking obstacle crossing module, a power supply module, a control module and the like. The advanced detection and the map construction of the post-disaster environment of the mine are realized by the multi-source cooperation collection of the post-disaster air environment, the geological morphology and the personnel information of the mine through various sensors, radars, life detectors, the carried metamorphic robot, the carried flying robot and the like of the robot. The system provides more scientific and comprehensive detection information for the rescue command center, helps rescue workers to make rescue decisions more quickly after rescue, and improves safety and high efficiency of actions after disaster.

title_en: Emergency calling apparatus for elevator
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 건물내 모기의 회선을 통한 인터폰 통화와, 비상 상황시에 인터폰 통화가 안되는 경우에 외부의 국선을 통한 유무선 전화 통화를 지원하는 엘리베이터 비상통화 연결장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 외부와 유무선 전화 통화를 지원하기 위한 가동에 필요한 전원으로 배터리 등의 별도의 전원공급수단을 사용하는 것이 아니라 국선의 전원을 이용하는 엘리베이터 비상통화 연결장치에 관한 것이다.  
본 고안에 따른 엘리베이터 비상통화 연결장치는 마이크 및 스피커를 이용한 통화를 지원하는 통화지원부와,  건물내 모기의 회선과 상기 통화지원부를 접속연결하는 트랜스정합부와,  외부의 국선과 상기 통화지원부를 접속연결하는 가입자선로정합부와,  상기 가입자선로정합부에 연결되는 상기 국선을 활성화시키는 선로선택부와,  비상버튼의 상태를 검출하여, 상기 트랜스정합부가 가동되도록 하는 비상버튼검출부와,  상기 트랜스정합부의 가동에 따른 상기 건물내 모기의 응답이 일정시간 이내에 없는 경우에 상기 선로선택부가 가동되도록 하는 슈퍼바이저부와,  상기 건물내 모기의 무응답으로 상기 선로선택부 및 가입자선로정합부가 가동되면 기설정된 외부전화로 발신되도록 하는 주제어부를 포함하여 이루어지되,  상기 슈퍼바이저부는 상기 국선의 전원을 구동전원으로 사용하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Public security patrol platform based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public security patrol control platform based on big data, which relates to the technical field of public security patrol control and comprises an area division module, a command center, a personnel distribution module and a patrol control scheduling module; the region division module is used for carrying out statistical analysis on the alarm condition data daily accumulated in the alarm condition information fusion data platform, and determining and dividing the patrol control region; the command center is used for issuing patrol tasks according to the divided patrol areas and analyzing patrol attraction values of the patrol areas by utilizing the personnel allocation module; then allocating a corresponding number of patrol personnel to execute patrol tasks according to the patrol attraction values; when patrolmen perform patrolling tasks, the patrolling scheduling module is used for counting and analyzing the time which is easy to generate the emergency warning situation in the patrolling area, and patrolling the patrolling area at different time periods and different frequencies; for a period of high occurrence of the alarm condition in a certain patrol area, the patrol frequency can be reasonably adjusted, the possible emergency alarm condition in the patrol area can be effectively monitored, and the alarm condition processing efficiency is improved.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGKE XINCHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine major disaster risk prevention and control system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine safety, in particular to a coal mine major disaster risk prevention and control system and method based on artificial intelligence, comprising a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a data processing module, a disaster prediction module, a decision support module and a user interaction module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires coal mine environment data, the data transmission module transmits the acquired environment data to a ground control center, the data processing module is used for ensuring the accuracy and consistency of data through data preprocessing, data fusion and anomaly detection, the disaster prediction module is used for predicting potential disasters and generating a risk assessment report, the decision support module is used for providing an intelligent decision proposal and an emergency proposal according to a prediction result, and the user interaction module is used for providing a visual interface.

title_en: Fire risk influence assessment method based on multi-source data space-time correlation analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and relates to a fire risk influence assessment method based on multi-source data space-time correlation analysis, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of multi-source data acquisition, text preprocessing, text word segmentation, fire sample set construction, keyword matching, named entity recognition, space-time matching, multi-source data fusion analysis, fire influence evaluation level judgment and result pushing, wherein the result of the fire influence evaluation level is pushed to an emergency command center system for reference decision of command personnel. The method realizes the efficient fusion of the multi-source unstructured alarm data and the structured event data, breaks the data island between the traditional alarm systems, realizes the event normalization processing through natural language processing and a space-time matching algorithm, avoids misjudgment and repeated response, improves the event identification accuracy, establishes a scientific and reasonable fire influence evaluation index system, and covers multiple dimensions such as site response intensity, casualties, social attention and the like.

title_en: Fire emergency water supply control system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency water supply control system and a method thereof, which relate to the technical field of fire control and comprise a distributed control network, a control system and a control system, wherein the distributed control network is used for establishing communication connection with a plurality of fire detection devices and a plurality of water supply devices, receiving and processing fire related parameters from various fire detection devices and controlling the operation of the water supply devices; the fire detection equipment is used for continuously collecting fire related parameters; a plurality of water supply devices including fire valves and fire pumps; the standby power supply module is used for supplying power to the system when the main power supply fails; and the remote monitoring and control module is used for carrying out data exchange with the fire control command center and receiving control instructions. The invention realizes accurate judgment and real-time tracking of fire conditions through multi-source information fusion and dynamic analysis, and greatly improves the accuracy and timeliness of system response.
assignees: LINFEN CITY YAODU DISTRICT XINJIAXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Speech digital network fire alarm design based on single chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a speech digital network fire alarm design system based on a single chip, wherein an AT89C51 single chip is used, an integrated temperature sensor AD590 and a gas sensor TGS202 are selected as the sensitive elements, and a speech digital network alarm applicable to the fire alarm of a small institute is developed by using a multi-sensor information fusion technology. The alarm hardware consists of a temperature smoke signal acquisition module, an audible and visual alarm module, the a single chip and a Modem communication module. The sudden change of the indoor smoke (CO2, CO) and temperature can be alarmed (audible and visual alarm); in the case of hardware faults (such as sensor drop, damage of internal device and the like), a fault alarm can be sent; if a parameter is abnormal (for example, the smoke concentration is excessively great or the temperature is excessively high,), an abnormity alarm signal can be sent such that the operator on duty can handle the situation on site; if both the smoke and the temperature are abnormal, a fire disaster happens, a fire alarm is sent, and the fire information is reported to a fire command center. The system is safe and reliable and ensures low rate of false alarm. Moreover, the system has wide application prospect due to the small size, convenient operation and maintenance, low cost, and the like.

title_en: Disaster risk dynamic analysis system based on unmanned aerial vehicle data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster risk dynamic analysis system based on unmanned aerial vehicle data, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, a data transmission module and a ground control center, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle platform comprises a data acquisition module, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring disaster site data, the data transmission module is used for transmitting the data in real time and accurately and has a data encryption function to ensure the data safety, and the ground control center comprises a data arrangement unit, a multi-source data fusion unit, a disaster prediction unit, an early warning unit and a display unit. According to the disaster development prediction method, various data can be collected rapidly through an unmanned aerial vehicle, the jagged data can be systematically processed through the data integration unit, and then the disaster can be analyzed and predicted through a prediction model constructed by a ground control center, so that the disaster development prediction accuracy and efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Traffic accident prevention system based on fusion big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic accident prevention system based on fusion big data analysis, which comprises a vehicle-mounted terminal, a big data fusion platform, a hidden danger factor analysis platform and a command center terminal, wherein the vehicle-mounted terminal is in communication connection with the command center terminal, the command center terminal is in communication connection with the hidden danger factor analysis platform, and the hidden danger factor analysis platform is in communication connection with the big data fusion platform; the vehicle-mounted terminal is provided with a unique identification number and is used for acquiring the position information of the vehicle and interacting with a driver; the big data fusion platform is used for acquiring data and fusing the acquired data; the hidden danger factor analysis platform is used for analyzing the information obtained by fusion processing in the big data fusion platform to obtain a hidden danger object list; and the command center terminal is used for displaying the hidden danger object list obtained by the hidden danger factor analysis platform, and reminding a driver through the vehicle-mounted terminal when the distance between the running vehicle and the accident site or the potential safety hazard road section is within a set range.
assignees: SICHUAN DIGIT LIGHTHOUSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Slope safety monitoring method and device based on multi-source heterogeneous sensor data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope safety monitoring method and device for multi-source heterogeneous sensor data fusion, which comprises the following steps: step 1: designing the number and the type of the multi-source heterogeneous sensors and the arrangement position according to the pre-monitored slope; step 2: arranging the multi-source heterogeneous sensors at corresponding positions of the side slope, connecting the multi-source heterogeneous sensors with a data transmission module, and wirelessly connecting the data transmission module with a control center module; and step 3: the data transmission module transmits the environmental parameters acquired by the multi-source heterogeneous sensor to the control center module, and the control center module performs data fusion analysis; and 4, step 4: and judging the stability grade of the side slope, and timely giving out early warning when the side slope is in a more unstable or unstable state.

title_en: Intelligent community comprehensive command center dispatching system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent community management and service, and discloses a dispatching system of an intelligent community integrated command center, which comprises a private domain intelligent body command dispatching service station, a communication coordination module and a feedback evaluation module, wherein the private domain intelligent body command dispatching service station is used for constructing a localized and trusted intelligent dispatching center on a community level, the service station comprises a data fusion module, a task analysis module, a resource matching module, a communication coordination module and a feedback evaluation module, and community intelligent manager nodes are deployed in a community public area and are in communication connection with the command dispatching service station and used for collecting community environment data, resident behavior data and public facility state data and executing dispatching instructions from the service station. The intelligent decision-making capability is extended from the center to the edge and the terminal through the three-level architecture of the private domain intelligent agent command dispatching service station, the community intelligent manager node and the household intelligent manager terminal, so that the load pressure of a center server is reduced, and the quick sensing and accurate response of community public affairs and household private domain requirements are realized.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHUYU IND GROUP CO LTD;SHANGHAI BATH & TECH RESEARCH CENTER

title_en: System and method for identifying dynamic hidden danger and evaluating risk of multi-information fusion special operation site
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-information fusion special operation site dynamic hidden danger identification and risk assessment system and method. The system comprises: the special operation artificial olfaction detection unit acquires a response signal generated by gas at a special operation site, and the special operation visual detection unit acquires image information and video information of the special operation site; the calculation control center receives and summarizes response signals, image information and video information generated by the gas in the special operation field; the multi-information fusion potential safety hazard identification unit carries out scene matching according to the collected response signals of artificial olfaction and the image video of visual detection, identifies according to a multi-information fusion algorithm and marks the position of a potential hazard; and the risk assessment and intelligent early warning unit carries out real-time risk assessment on the risk degree in the operation process according to a risk grading algorithm. The invention solves the problems of lack of manual monitoring and safety monitoring information, incomplete identification factors, low detection accuracy, early warning lag and the like in the current special operation.

title_en: A non-face-to-face electronic loan service system using a metabus platform
title_ko: 메타버스 플랫폼을 활용한 비대면 전자대출 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-face-to-face electronic loan service system utilizing a metaverse platform, and more specifically, has the effect of providing a non-face-to-face electronic loan service between users and financial institutions without information leakage on the blockchain-based metaverse platform by accessing the blockchain-based metaverse platform, users may perform credit consultation (ChatBot) and application through the financial service department after signing up for membership through the membership registration form on the user terminal, and automatically submit personal and business owner authentication and ERP data, and receiving and confirming financial self-diagnosis, the personal and business owner authentication and the ERP data through the diagnosis service department, and monitoring the progress of the credit, verifying the business registration number and representative stated on the business registration certificate as business owner and representative authentication is carried out simultaneously with the credit application and is accessed through Hometax, proceeding with representative's identity verification to confirm that he/she is the representative of the applicant business through mobile authentication in the person's name and verification of the real-name account of the transaction bank, automatically transmitting data whose information consistency is verified by comparing it with Hometax information to the financial institution server for credit application after selecting the business registration number, data base year, and transmission data to obtain information by accessing an ERP system server linked to the service when applying for the credit, and identifying industry analysis, competitor analysis, business partner analysis, financial credit analysis, future projections, and diagnosis results reports through self-diagnosis.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 메타버스 플랫폼을 활용한 비대면 전자대출 서비스 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 이용자 단말기에서 회원가입부를 통해 회원 가입한 후 블록체인 기반 메타버스 플랫폼에 접속하여 금융서비스부를 통해 여신상담(ChatBot) 및 신청과, 본인 및 사업자 인증과 ERP 자료의 자동 제출을 수행하고, 진단서비스부를 통해 재무 자가진단과, 본인 및 사업자 인증과 ERP 자료를 수신하여 확인하고, 여신의 진행 상황을 모니터링함으로써, 블록체인 기반 메타버스 플랫폼에서 정보의 유출 없이 이용자와 금융기관 간의 비대면 전자대출 서비스를 제공할 수 있고, 사업자 및 대표자 인증은 여신신청시 동시 진행됨은 물론 Hometax에 접속하여 사업자등록증에 명시된 사업자번호와 대표자를 확인할 수 있고, 신청 사업자의 대표자임을 확인하는 대표자 본인인증은 본인명의 모바일 인증 및 거래은행의 실명계좌 확인을 통해 진행할 수 있으며, 여신 신청시 서비스와 연계되어 있는 ERP시스템 서버에 접근하여 사업자번호, 자료기준년도, 전송자료를 선택하여 정보를 입수한 후 Hometax 정보와 비교하여 정보 정합성이 인증된 자료를 여신 신청을 위해 금융기관서버로 자동 전송할 수 있음은 물론 자가진단을 통해 산업분석, 경쟁기업 분석, 거래처 분석, 재무신용도 분석, 미래추정 및 진단결과보고서를 파악할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Safety monitoring system and method for marine riser in soft suspension state
abstract_en: The invention relates to a riser safety monitoring system and a method in a soft suspension state, wherein the system comprises a riser stress-strain monitoring system, a top flexible joint inclination angle monitoring system, a laser interference monitoring system, an information fusion center and a platform control center; the platform control center sends typhoon early warning instructions to each monitoring system when typhoon or other dangerous conditions exist near the platform; the stress-strain monitoring system of the information marine riser measures the stress-strain parameters of the marine riser in real time; the top flexible joint inclination angle monitoring system measures deflection angle parameters of a flexible joint at the top of the marine riser in real time; the laser interference monitoring system measures the central offset parameter of the marine riser in real time; the information fusion center compares each real-time measurement value with the parameter early warning value, and when the real-time measurement value is greater than the parameter early warning value, the information fusion center sends early warning information to the platform control center; the platform control center adjusts the speed and the direction of the platform. The invention can be widely applied to the petroleum pipeline monitoring field.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CNOOC RES INST CO LTD;CHINA OILFIELD SERVICES LTD

title_en: Information and command integration method in security field based on information fusion technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an information and command integrated method in the security field based on an information fusion technology, which comprises data fusion, system fusion and service fusion, wherein an information system generates event early warning through comprehensive information analysis and pushes two levels of early warning of emergency and emergency to a command center alarm receiving and processing system to generate early warning events; the information system carries out information research and judgment through comprehensive information analysis means such as dynamic management of key personnel and attention on most key objects, and the research and judgment results are pushed to the emergency command combat system; the system pushes the final information research and judgment result to a decision-making department in real time, and performs visual display through a large screen, an intelligent terminal and a GIS, quickly establishes a command model, and assists in performing accurate decision-making and one-key scheduling.
assignees: CHINA CHANGFENG SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY IND GROUP CORP

title_en: Safety management system using electronic safety fence based on composite sensor and safety management method
title_ko: 복합 센서 기반의 전자 안전펜스를 이용한 안전 관리 시스템 및 안전 관리 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment, disclosed are a safety management system and a safety management method using a composite sensor-based electronic safety fence. The safety management system includes: an electronic safety fence including an imaging unit capturing an image of an object and a sensor unit outputting an ultrasonic signal to an approaching object and receiving an ultrasonic signal reflected from the object; and an integrated control center receiving the ultrasonic signal and the image from the electronic safety fence, estimating the location of the object based on the provided ultrasonic signal, generating a monitoring image by matching between the estimated object location and the image, and displaying the generated monitoring image. The electronic safety fence includes: multiple slave fences; and a master fence collecting the ultrasonic signal and the image from the slave fences and providing the signal and the image for the integrated control center.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 의한 복합 센서 기반의 전자 안전펜스를 이용한 안전 관리 시스템 및 안전 관리 방법이 개시된다. 상기 안전 관리 시스템은 접근하는 대상체에 초음파 신호를 출력하여 상기 대상체에 반사된 초음파 신호를 수신하는 센서부와 상기 대상체의 영상을 촬영하는 촬영부를 포함하는 전자 안전펜스; 및 상기 전자 안전펜스로부터 상기 초음파 신호와 상기 영상을 제공받고 상기 제공받은 초음파 신호를 기초로 상기 대상체의 위치를 추정하고, 상기 추정된 대상체의 위치와 상기 영상을 정합하여 감시 영상을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 감시 영상을 디스플레이하는 통합 관제센터를 포함하고, 상기 전자 안전펜스는 다수의 슬레이브 펜스와 상기 다수의 슬레이브 펜스로부터 상기 초음파 신호와 상기 영상을 수집하여 상기 통합 관제센터에 제공하는 마스터 펜스를 포함한다.

title_en: Wisdom mine platform system architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart mining platform system structure in the technical field of mining platforms, which comprises an industrial Internet system, a big data and private cloud center, a production management and control subsystem, a production automation subsystem, a dispatching monitoring system and a safety management and control subsystem; the networking transmission of the industrial Internet system adopts a loop network mode networking, the video monitoring system is used for independent transmission, the reliability of the whole network and the survivability under emergency conditions are ensured, the network communication stability of equipment is ensured through a station and line thought of '1+1', the normal data transmission is ensured, the high reliability and high robustness of various monitoring and remote control system operation of the system are ensured, the intelligent analysis and early warning linkage of mine disasters are realized on the basis of centralized control and data fusion, and safety accidents are avoided; the new mine management mode is based on a data center, a centralized control center and the like, and is based on an intelligent mine management and control system, and is based on closed-loop management and control with high integration and intelligent analysis as main characteristics, and the responsibility is clear.
assignees: ANHUI CRRC RUIDA ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode city security video abnormal behavior real-time detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode urban security video abnormal behavior real-time detection system and method, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence and urban security, and comprise an edge node module, a central coordination server module, a dynamic federal policy module and an alarm linkage module, wherein the edge node module is used for collecting local video streams and sensor data, executing local model training and real-time abnormal detection, the central coordination server module is used for federal model parameter aggregation, global model distribution and dynamic resource coordination, the multi-mode data fusion module is used for realizing cross-mode feature fusion through a space-time alignment and attention mechanism, the dynamic federal policy module is used for calculating load and network state according to edge nodes, self-adaptively adjusting model parameter aggregation frequency, and the alarm linkage module is used for triggering local acousto-optic alarm when abnormal behaviors are detected and encrypting and transmitting event information to a command center. The invention can solve the problems of privacy disclosure, bandwidth pressure and multi-mode data collaboration in the prior art, minimize calculation overhead and adapt to heterogeneous equipment on the premise of ensuring data privacy.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Light pole alarm deduplication analysis method and system based on Bian Yun cooperative computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lamp post alarm deduplication analysis method and system based on Bian Yun cooperative calculation; wherein the method comprises: the edge gateway obtains an analysis request sent by the control center server, and if the analysis request is continuous frame operation analysis, the collected video is sent to the cloud server; if the discontinuous frame operation analysis is performed, the collected video is processed in the edge gateway; the edge gateway is arranged inside the street lamp pole; after receiving the video, the cloud server and the edge gateway firstly judge whether the required computing resources exceed a set threshold value, if not, the video is subjected to structural analysis, and the cloud server feeds the analysis result back to the edge gateway; and the edge gateway judges repeated data according to the structural analysis result, sends alarm information to the control center server according to the judgment result, and links related equipment.

title_en: Slope safety monitoring method and device for multi-source heterogeneous sensor data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope safety monitoring method and device for multi-source heterogeneous sensor data fusion, comprising the following steps of 1, designing the number and types of multi-source heterogeneous sensors and layout positions according to a pre-monitored slope, 2, arranging the multi-source heterogeneous sensors at corresponding positions of the slope, connecting the multi-source heterogeneous sensors with a data transmission module, and wirelessly connecting the data transmission module with a control center module, 3, transmitting environmental parameters acquired by the multi-source heterogeneous sensors to the control center module by the data transmission module, and carrying out data fusion analysis by the control center module, 4, judging the stability grade of the slope, and timely giving out early warning when the slope is in a relatively unstable or unstable state.

title_en: Ore earthquake detection life information detection and transmission device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining earthquake detection and storage life information detection and transmission device, which relates to the technical field of life information detection and search and rescue. The mining earthquake detection life information detection and transmission device can rapidly collect and organically fuse various different kinds of information such as gas, environment, temperature, life information and the like of a region to be detected in real time when collapse accidents such as coal mine collapse and earthquake disasters occur, and can transmit the information of the region to be detected to a ground command center in real time and reliably by utilizing a computer technology, a wireless and wired transmission technology, a heterogeneous sensor technology, an information fusion technology and the like, and can transmit rescue instructions of rescue command centers at all levels to the scene.

title_en: System for rescuing emergency employing biometric techniques of solid space and hololens
title_ko: 3차원공간에서의 생체객체와 현실객체의 정합기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The embodiment relates to an emergency patient rescue system using a technology for aligning a bio-object and a real object in a three-dimensional space. Specifically, the rescue system provides a three-dimensional bio-object recognition and alignment method that maximizes intelligent realism and immersion by applying MR technology to an emergency situation where on-site support is impossible. The emergency patient rescue system using a technology for aligning a bio-object and a real object in a three-dimensional space includes: an MR device that is individually equipped for a plurality of different users and acquires an MR (Mixed Reality) image by synchronously processing bio-object recognition and real object recognition in a three-dimensional space for a surrounding patient; a portable integrated controller that is installed around the MR device and processes the MR image of the MR device and additional information including the body temperature and location of a registration sensor and surrounding environment information, registration structure content, and interaction between the user and the patient according to the registration structure scenario, and collectively provides the information to a remote registration management server; and a management server that checks the patient's condition at a remote location and provides guidance and rescue according to the information provided by the portable integrated controller. According to embodiments, the on-site situation is transmitted to a medical control center using an MR device and high-speed wireless communication, and emergency responders can receive medical guidance from the medical control center and provide treatment.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 3차원공간에서의 생체객체와 현실객체의 정합기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 이러한 구조 시스템은 현장지원이 불가능한 응급 상황에 MR 기술을 적용하여 지능화된 현실감 및 몰입감을 극대화하는 3차원 생체객체 인식 및 정합 방식을 제공한다. 그리고, 이러한 방식은 MR 디바이스를 활용한 MR기반으로 제작된 콘텐츠(현장 초동조치, 구급차 탑승 후 조치, 현장 의료조치 도구)를 통하여 만들어진다. 
그래서, 이러한 방식으로 초기 의료대응을 위하여 현장의 상황을 의료상황실로 전송하고 응급처치 요원이 의료상황실의 의료지도를 받아 처치하는 원격 의료지원을 제공한다. 이러한 경우, 현장 상황 전송은 MR 디바이스를 이용하여 고속 통신을 활용한 영상, 음성 등 원활한 정보 송수신으로 응급상황에 신속하게 대응한다. 예를 들어, 현장에서 필요한 MR 디바이스를 이용한 처리 부문(3차원공간 생체객체 인식 및 정합, 영상전송, 스냅샷 전송, 음성인식 및 음성합성(TTS), MR 콘텐츠 디스플레이 등)과 원격 의료상황실용(상황 모니터링, 처치 지도 등)으로 구분해서 만든다. 
이러한 경우, MR기반 현장 초동조치와, 구급차 탑승 후 조치, 의료조치 등으로 구분하여, 구조 콘텐츠와 구조 시나리오를 만든다. 그리고, 이러한 구조 콘텐츠와 구조 시나리오에 사용자 또는 환자와의 상호작용을 처리하여, 현장상황에 적절한 구조 정보를 제공한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 실시예에서는 MR 디바이스와 고속 무선통신 등을 이용하여 현장의 상황을 의료상황실로 전송하고 응급처치요원이 의료상황실의 의료지도를 받아 처치를 제공할 수 있도록 한다. 
그리고, 현장지원이 불가능한 응급 상황에서 3차원 공간의 생체객체 인식 및 정합 기술 이용한 MR 기반의 의료 대응을 제공한다.

title_en: Emergency response and repair method for routing of underwater pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency response and repair method for an underwater pipeline route, which comprises the following steps of S1, firstly placing a detection device into a pipeline along the flowing direction of a fluid medium, S2, starting a measuring instrument of a head mechanism, carrying out data fusion and transmitting the data to a control center of the head mechanism in real time, S3, opening a fan plate, starting a propeller on the head mechanism and a propeller on a propelling mechanism, wherein the two mechanisms work together to realize the swimming and steering movement of the detection device in the pipeline, the sensor is used for detecting the condition in the pipeline, S4, when the head mechanism detects that the flow velocity is suddenly changed in the pipeline, the fan plate is retracted, the propeller and an axial propeller are closed, the descending propeller is started to enable the detection device to be attached to the inner wall of the pipeline, S5, the crawling mechanism drives the detection device to creep, S6, when the flow velocity trend is changed from rising to descending trend, the fixing device is arranged on the inner wall of the pipeline, S7, the repair mechanism works, and S8, the monitoring ring is started. The invention can automatically and efficiently detect and repair the pipeline in an automatic way.

title_en: Cctv system for intelligent security and method thereof
title_ko: 지능형 보안방범을 위한 폐쇄회로티브이 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A CCTV system for intelligent security and a method thereof are provided to enable a manager to directly set an area for security and set conditions of various accident types which can occur by setting an object. A security crime situation recognizing module(500) recognizes a security crime situation through matching of interesting accident types registered in a setting DB. A security crime situation managing module(600) stores all interesting accident type information and situation information provided from the security crime situation recognizing module in a situation managing DB. A security crime situation alarm module(700) generates alarm information due to a situation of each interesting accident type of security crime situation recognizing information transmitted from the security crime situation recognizing module. A security crime situation service module(800) provides a service necessary for security by using the alarm information and situation information related to security crime recognition.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지능형 보안방범을 위한 폐쇄회로티브이(CCTV) 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 하나 이상의 영상입력장치로 구성되어 복수의 영상을 결합하고 전송하는 영상입력모듈; 상기 영상입력모듈에서 입력된 영상으로부터 카메라 설정에 따른 정지영상을 캡처하고, 보안방범을 위한 영역과 관심 객체를 지정하여 해당 사건들에 대한 관심사건의 유형을 설계하며, 설계된 유형들에 대한 상황을 설정하여 보안방범 관심상황설정DB에 등록하는 보안방범 상황설정모듈; 상기 보안방범 상황설정모듈에서 설정된 관심사건의 유형을 저장하여 영상분석모듈과 보안방범 상황인지모듈에 관심사건의 유형정보를 제공하는 보안방범 관심상황설정DB; 상기 보안방범 관심상황설정DB에 등록된 관심사건 유형으로부터 관심영역만을 대상으로 영상입력모듈을 경유하여 입력되는 동영상으로부터 실시간 영상분석을 수행하여 객체를 검지하고, 객체의 종류를 분류하며, 관심 객체를 추적하여 보안방범 상황인지를 위해 필요한 영역정보 및 객체정보와 사건정보를 보안방범 인지모듈에 전달하는 영상분석모듈; 상기 영상분석모듈로부터 전달된 정보를 조합하고 보안방범 관심상황설정DB에 등록된 관심사건 유형 사이의 정합을 통하여 보안방범 상황인지를 수행하고, 그 결과를 보안방범 상황관리모듈과 보안방범 상황알람모듈에 전송하는 보안방범 상황인지모듈; 상기 보안방범 상황인지모듈에서 인지되어 제공된 모든 관심사건 유형정보 및 상황정보를 보안방범 상황관리DB에 저장하고, 보안방범 상황서비스모듈로부터 요구되는 보안방범 상황인지정보의 검색 및 갱신과 삭제 등의 요청에 관 한 정보를 보안방범 상황관리DB로부터 제공하는 보안방범 상황관리모듈; 상기 보안방범 상황설정모듈로부터 설정된 보안방범의 다양한 상황에 따른 알람의 등급정보 및 알람의 통보방식을 정의 및 관리하고, 보안방범 상황인지모듈에서 전송된 보안방범 상황인지정보의 각 관심사건 유형별로 상황에 따른 알람정보를 생성하여 보안방범 상황서비스모듈에 통보하는 보안방범 상황알람모듈; 상기 보안방범 상황알람모듈에 의해 통보되는 알람정보와 보안방범 상황관리모듈을 통하여 보안방범 상황관리DB에서 제공되는 보안방범 인지와 관련된 상황정보를 활용하여 보안방범에 필요한 서비스를 제공하는 보안방범 상황인지정보의 수요자에 해당하는 관리자 및 소프트웨어와 시스템을 포함하는 보안방범 상황서비스모듈; 상기 보안방범 상황관리모듈에 의해 등록되거나 관리되는 보안방범 인지정보를 저장하고, 보안방범 상황관리모듈로부터 요구되는 다양한 보안방범 인지정보를 제공하기 위하여 일정기간동안 메모리 역할을 수행하는 보안방범 상황관리DB를 포함하는 시스템의 제공으로, 보안방범을 필요로 하는 지역에서 요구되는 보다 효율적이고 실질적인 안전을 도모한 것이다. 
       
     지능형, 보안방범, 관심영역, 객체, 사건, 폐쇄회로티브이

title_en: Mine post-disaster environment advanced detection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine post-disaster environment advanced detection robot which comprises key component modules such as an environment advanced detection module, a communication module, an information fusion module, a carrying module, a walking obstacle crossing module, a power supply module, a control module and the like. The advanced detection and the map construction of the post-disaster environment of the mine are realized by the multi-source cooperation collection of the post-disaster air environment, the geological morphology and the personnel information of the mine through various sensors, radars, life detectors, the carried metamorphic robot, the carried flying robot and the like of the robot. The system provides more scientific and comprehensive detection information for the rescue command center, helps rescue workers to make rescue decisions more quickly after rescue, and improves safety and high efficiency of actions after disaster.

title_en: Direct calling system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an elevator emergency calling system and, more specifically, to a direct calling system which provides direct calling between people in an elevator and an emergency spreader. The direct calling system comprises: a circuit matching unit which forms a calling channel with an emergency calling device inside an elevator; a memory which stores a calling progress message, an emergency spreader terminal information, and a field identification information used when a maintenance office does not respond to an emergency calling; a key input unit and a display unit which displays input of the emergency spreader terminal information and the field identification information; a PSTN matching unit which forms a calling channel with a public telephone network; a PSTN connection sensing unit which senses connection with the public telephone network; and a control unit which forms a calling channel between the emergency calling device and the emergency spreader terminal when an intercom of the maintenance office does not respond to an emergency calling signal generated from the emergency calling device. The control unit reads the calling progress message indicating that a calling from the memory is in progress in order to control a voice transmission to the emergency calling device and call the emergency spreader terminal through the public telephone network; and forms a calling channel between the emergency calling device, generating the emergency calling, and the emergency spreader terminal when a response exists.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 승강기 비상호출 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 승강기 탑승자와 비상상황 전파자 사이에 직접 통화가 가능한 직접통화장치에 관한 것으로, 각 승강기 내의 비상호출기와 통화로 형성하기 위한 회선 정합부와; 비상호출시 관리실 인터폰이 무응답할 경우 이용하기 위한 호출진행 메시지 및 비상상황 전파자 단말정보, 현장식별정보가 저장되는 메모리와; 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말정보 및 현장식별정보를 입력 표시하기 위한 키입력부 및 표시부와; 공중전화망과 통화로 형성하기 위한 PSTN 정합부와; 공중전화망의 연결을 감지하기 위한 PSTN 연결 감지부와; 상기 비상호출기로부터 발생된 비상호출신호에 관리실 인터폰이 무응답할 경우 해당 비상호출기와 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말 사이에 통화로를 형성해 주기 위한 제어부;를 포함하되, 상기 제어부는 상기 관리실 인터폰 무응답시 상기 메모리에서 현재 호출 진행중임을 지시하는 호출진행 메시지를 독출하여 해당 비상호출기로 음성 송출 제어하면서 공중전화망을 통해 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말을 호출하고, 그 응답이 있을 경우 비상호출 발생한 비상호출기와 비상상황 전파자 단말 사이에 통화로를 형성해 줌을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Multi-source information fusion and intelligent decision method for emergency call terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource information fusion and intelligent decision method of an emergency call terminal, which relates to the technical field of emergency call terminals and comprises a system body, wherein a plurality of layers are arranged in the system body and respectively comprise a sensing layer, a transmission layer, a data processing layer, a decision layer and an application layer, a data acquisition module is arranged in the sensing layer, a communication module is arranged in the transmission layer, a data preprocessing module and a multisource information fusion module are arranged in the data processing layer, an intelligent decision module is arranged in the decision layer, an instruction output module is arranged in the application layer, and an image acquisition unit for acquiring image data of a disaster site, a voice acquisition unit for collecting voice information of the site and a sensor unit for acquiring ambient temperature and humidity are respectively arranged in the data acquisition module.
assignees: HUBEI NORTH STAR TIMES INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned vehicle monitoring method and device based on global perception and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for monitoring an unmanned vehicle based on global perception, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring static environment information and dynamic event environment information based on global environment perception; receiving external input emergency information; information fusion is carried out according to the static environment information and the dynamic event environment information, and associated event information of the emergency information is determined; and generating a control decision according to the associated event information. According to the unmanned vehicle monitoring method, device and storage medium based on the global perception, provided by the embodiment of the invention, the cloud control center is mainly used for acquiring the perception information and determining the associated event information of the emergency information based on the fusion of the perception information, so that a corresponding control decision is generated. Therefore, the overall control of the cloud control center on the unmanned vehicles is realized, and the technical problem that the monitoring on the unmanned vehicles in the prior art seriously depends on the operation of equipment of the unmanned vehicles and cannot realize the overall control on the unmanned vehicle group is solved.
assignees: ZHONGKE DALU QINGDAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visual self-organization-based method for constructing temporary communication network of unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a temporary communication network of an unmanned aerial vehicle group based on visual self-organization. The method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle node system and a security audit management system to realize flight control and message encryption exchange, realizing airborne perception through a visual candidate site identification system, carrying out multi-mode data fusion and site scoring, realizing field autonomy and weighted election through a distributed voting and election system, determining a relay node, completing multi-hop path scheduling, monitoring and self-adaptive reconstruction based on a multi-hop relay and route maintenance system, and executing target detection, positioning and emergency reporting through a search and rescue positioning and situation returning system. The method can quickly recover the voice and data links when the ground communication facilities are damaged or unavailable, and enables the unmanned aerial vehicle group to autonomously and distributively identify the safe position and negotiate to establish a reliable multi-hop communication network under the condition of limited communication and energy, thereby supporting emergency rescue and positioning service.
assignees: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY TAIZHOU

title_en: Safety monitoring system and method for marine riser in soft suspension state
abstract_en: The invention relates to a riser safety monitoring system and a method in a soft suspension state, wherein the system comprises a riser stress-strain monitoring system, a top flexible joint inclination angle monitoring system, a laser interference monitoring system, an information fusion center and a platform control center; the platform control center sends typhoon early warning instructions to each monitoring system when typhoon or other dangerous conditions exist near the platform; the stress-strain monitoring system of the information marine riser measures the stress-strain parameters of the marine riser in real time; the top flexible joint inclination angle monitoring system measures deflection angle parameters of a flexible joint at the top of the marine riser in real time; the laser interference monitoring system measures the central offset parameter of the marine riser in real time; the information fusion center compares each real-time measurement value with the parameter early warning value, and when the real-time measurement value is greater than the parameter early warning value, the information fusion center sends early warning information to the platform control center; the platform control center adjusts the speed and the direction of the platform. The invention can be widely applied to the petroleum pipeline monitoring field.

title_en: Distributed fire positioning alarm device, system and method based on multi-sensor information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed fire positioning alarm device, a system and a method based on multi-sensor information fusion, wherein the alarm device comprises a wireless detection device, a wireless detection device and a wireless detection device, wherein the wireless detection device comprises a plurality of wireless nodes distributed in a detection space, and each wireless node comprises a sensing module and a wireless node controller in signal connection with the sensing module; the fire alarm controller is used for integrating alarm signals of all wireless nodes into fire alarm positioning signals, and the communication device comprises an internal communication module and an external communication module. The system has the advantages that the system response speed and accuracy are improved by simultaneously monitoring a plurality of parameters such as temperature, smoke, flame, CO, O  2  and the like in real time and analyzing and judging through a fusion algorithm, so that signs of fire hazard are found early, the false alarm rate and the missing alarm rate are reduced, automatic alarm is realized, alarm signals of wireless nodes are uniformly received and integrated through a fire alarm controller and then are sent to an external fire control center, and quick and accurate positioning and fire extinguishing are ensured.

title_en: Intelligent event sponsor unit identification method for grid command center platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent identification method for an event sponsor unit of a grid command center platform, and relates to the technical fields of urban management informatization and intelligent command scheduling. The method comprises the steps of obtaining event information comprising event description text and field images, extracting feature vectors of the text and the images, carrying out deep fusion on the two feature vectors to generate multi-mode event feature vectors, inquiring a pre-constructed knowledge graph based on the feature vectors, searching an initial sponsor unit set, filtering and optimizing the initial set according to real-time resource states of the sponsor units, and outputting a final sponsor unit list. The method solves the problems of inaccurate identification, low efficiency, low resource matching degree and the like of the sponsor units in the prior art, combines real-time resource states through multi-mode information fusion and knowledge graph semantic reasoning, realizes the intelligent identification of the event sponsor units with accurate, efficient and usability guarantee, and effectively improves the processing efficiency and resource allocation rationality of the gridding events.
assignees: BEIHAI CITY AREA SOCIAL GOVERNMENT GRID GUEHUA COMMAND CENTER;GUANGXI CHENGSHI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Automatic response system for same contents 119 call
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic answering machine connected to a report phone line of a 119 situation room to allow the 119 situation room to response to all situations without delay even if a plurality of situations occur at the same time zone by filtering duplicate reports with the automatic answering machine in order to prevent occurrence of a situation that 119 report phone calls of other accidents can not be received due to occupancy of all report phone lines of the 119 situation room by congestion of 119 report phone calls with the same content when fire and rescue situations occur. According to the present invention, a procedure that a report phone call originated within a predetermined distance around an accident occurrence point is connected to the automatic answering machine to be hung up by being notified that a rescue team is already responded in case of the same content, and a report for requesting a rescue in a corresponding accident field or a report for providing necessary information or a report for other accidents is connected to a worker for a telephone conversation by pressing a guide button to take a measure without delay for all situations by the 119 situation room, is performed. Therefore, when the 119 situation room uses a system of the present invention, a report reception for other accidents occurring in the same time zone can be performed without delay by preventing occupancy of report phone lines of the 119 situation room by having several reports with the same content at the same time when fire and rescue situations occur.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재·구조·구급 상황이 발생하였을 때 같은 내용의 119신고전화가 폭주하여 119상황실의 모든 신고전화회선이 잠식되어 또 다른 사고의 119신고전화를 받을 수 없는 상황이 발생하지 않게 함을 목적으로, 자동응답기로 중복된 신고를 거름으로써 같은 시간대에 다수의 상황이 발생하여도 모든 상황에 대해 119상황실이 지체 없이 대응할 수 있도록 한 119상황실의 신고전화회선에 연결하는 자동응답기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에서는 사고가 발생한 지점을 중심으로 일정 거리 내에서 발신된 신고전화는 자동응답기로 연결시켜 같은 내용의 신고이면 이미 출동하였음을 알려 전화를 끊게 하고, 당해 사고현장에서 구조를 요청하거나 필요한 정보를 제공할 목적의 신고이거나 다른 사고의 신고이면 안내하는 버튼을 누르게 하여 근무자와 통화를 연결함으로써 모든 상황에 대해 119상황실이 지체 없이 조치를 취하게 하는 절차로 되어 있다. 
119상황실에서 본 발명 시스템을 쓰면 화재·구조·구급 상황 발생 시 동시에 여러 건의 같은 내용 신고가 이루어져 119상황실 신고전화회선을 잠식하는 것을 방지함으로써 같은 시간대에 발생한 다른 사고에 대한 신고접수가 지체 없이 이루어질 수 있다.

title_en: Safety monitoring system and method based on multi-mode data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety monitoring system and a safety monitoring method based on multi-mode data fusion, which relate to the technical field of safety monitoring and comprise a monitoring center, wherein the monitoring center is in communication connection with a multi-source data acquisition module, a data processing fusion module, a safety evaluation module and an emergency response module; the method comprises the steps of arranging a plurality of acquisition points and a plurality of types of sensors through a multi-source data acquisition module to form a sensor contact network to acquire multi-source sensing data, denoising and correcting the data of the multi-source sensing data through a data processing fusion module, fusing the multi-source sensing data to generate a fusion data set, carrying out pattern recognition through a safety evaluation module to further identify the real-time environment state associated with the current fusion data set, generating an emergency report through an emergency response module and triggering corresponding emergency measures, and therefore efficient and accurate safety monitoring is achieved.

title_en: Search and rescue system and search and rescue method based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and provides a search and rescue system and a search and rescue method based on cloud computing. The search and rescue system comprises: the cloud processing platform is used for carrying out information fusion on the search and rescue task information, the collected information and the search and rescue resource information to generate rescue situation information; the comprehensive control center is used for determining information related to the area to be searched and rescuing, further determining a search and rescue path to determine a search and rescue scheme and generating a rescue scheduling instruction; the communication unit is used for distributing rescue scheduling instructions to the rescue resource control console; and the rescue resource control console executes the search and rescue task based on the received rescue scheduling instruction. The method solves the problem that the materials cannot be effectively scheduled due to the fact that the search and rescue resources cannot be shared, can quickly determine the search and rescue path to determine the search and rescue scheme, generates the rescue scheduling instruction, and distributes the rescue scheduling instruction to control execution of the search and rescue scheme.

title_en: Fire scene firefighter positioning method assisted by smoke alarm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene firefighter positioning method assisted by a smoke alarm, which comprises the following steps: a smoke alarm is arranged in the protection area and comprises a smoke sensing module and a positioning module; when smoke is detected, the positioning module and a battery power supply mode are activated, and the positioning module periodically broadcasts positioning signals to the space; when fire fighters carry the positioning terminal to enter a fire disaster area, the positioning terminal receives the positioning signal broadcast by the smoke alarm in real time, obtains the received signal strength RSSI value, analyzes the MAC address of the smoke alarm, carries out self-position fusion calculation and Kalman filtering, takes the filtering result as the position estimation of the positioning terminal, and returns the position estimation to a command center through an emergency communication network. The invention has the technical characteristics of multi-source data fusion and is beneficial to constructing a fire fighter real-time positioning system in a fire scene.
assignees: SHANGHAI SPACEFLIGHT MEASUREMENT & CONTROL COMMUNICATION INST

title_en: System for rescuing emergency employing biometric techniques of solid space and hololens
title_ko: 홀로렌즈와 3차원공간에서의 생체인식기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템
abstract_ko:
실시예는 홀로렌즈와 3차원공간에서의 생체인식기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 이러한 구조 시스템은 초기 의료대응을 위하여 사용자 주변에 현장의 상황을 의료상황실 등으로 전송하고 응급처치 요원이 의료상황실의 의료지도를 받아 처치를 제공한다. 
구체적으로는, MR 디바이스 측에서 다수의 상이한 사용자별로 설치되어서, 사용자 주변에 현장에서 영상을 촬영하여 홀로렌즈로 투영해서 입체 영상을 수집하여 관리 정보처리장치에 일괄적으로 전달한다. 
그리고, 또한 이러한 경우에 MR 디바이스에서는 입체 영상을 전달할 경우마다, 해당 입체 공간에서의 현장 대상에 대한 생체 객체를 등록 생체 객체와의 비교를 통해 상이한 사용자별로 인식하고, 현장 대상의 실제 객체와 인식한 생체 객체를 정합하여 전달한다. 
이때, MR 디바이스에서는 생체 정보를 입체 공간에서 일실시예의 생체 정보의 인식을 위한 아날로그 클러스터링 인식포맷으로 인식하므로, 생체 정보를 선형적으로 인식하여 원활하게 인식을 한다. 
그러면, 관리 정보처리장치 측에서는 이러한 MR 디바이스에 의해 전달받은 각각의 입체 영상 내 객체와 응급 환자에 관한 설정 이상 객체를 비교하여 응급 환자의 발생 여부를 판별한다. 
그래서, 상기 판별 결과, 응급 환자가 발생한 경우에는 응급 구조정보를 구성하여 내부(또는, 외부 등록 구조 장치)로 알림한다. 반면에 응급 환자가 발생하지 않는 경우에는 알림하지 않으므로, 구조를 수행한다. 
예를 들어, 이러한 경우에, MR 디바이스에서는 상기 관리 정보처리장치로부터 해당 구조 콘텐츠에 따른 구조 정보를 제공받아서, 상기 구조 정보로 상기 MR 디스플레이의 동작을 제어하여 안내한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 실시예에서는 MR 디바이스 등에서 모니터링한 정보를 관리 정보처리장치에 제공할 경우 등에, 사용자 측에서 홀로렌즈를 통한 감시영상을 획득하여 입체적으로 정보분석해서 현장에 있는 특정한 대상의 생체정보를 신속하게 얻는다. 
그리고 나서, 이러한 정보를 원격지의 관리 정보처리장치에 전달하여 응급 조치를 즉시 받을 수 있도록 함으로써, 응급 환자 등이 발생한 상황에서 신속하게 구조 등을 제공하고 원활하게 할 수 있도록 도움을 준다.

title_en: Search and rescue system and search and rescue method based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and provides a search and rescue system and a search and rescue method based on cloud computing. This search and rescue system includes: the cloud processing platform is used for carrying out information fusion on the search and rescue task information, the collected information and the search and rescue resource information to generate rescue situation information; the comprehensive control center is used for determining information related to the area to be searched and rescued, further determining a search and rescue path to determine a search and rescue scheme and generating a rescue scheduling instruction; the communication unit is used for distributing rescue scheduling instructions to the rescue resource console; and the rescue resource console executes the search and rescue task based on the received rescue scheduling instruction. The method and the device solve the problem that the search and rescue resources cannot be shared to cause the problem that goods and materials cannot be effectively scheduled, can quickly determine the search and rescue path to determine the search and rescue scheme, generate the rescue scheduling instruction, and distribute the rescue scheduling instruction to control the execution of the search and rescue scheme.
assignees: BEIJING TAIJI JIANGTAI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Low-altitude target detection, identification and countercontrol prevention and control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of low altitude prevention and control technology, particularly to a low altitude target detection, recognition, and countermeasure prevention and control system, comprising an operation and maintenance management platform, a multi-source data fusion unit, an intelligent noise reduction preprocessing unit, a general command platform, a dynamic threat assessment unit, and a cross domain collaborative interface module. The present invention improves the accuracy and efficiency of detection and recognition through intelligent noise reduction and multi-source data fusion, achieves intelligent collaborative countermeasures through an intelligent decision-making center and a full chain countermeasure unit, strengthens the overall situational awareness through cross domain data collaboration, and optimizes operation and maintenance management and system stability through a predictive maintenance module and modular architecture. It can make up for the shortcomings of existing systems in China, ensure the safety of key scene airspace, and reduce long-term operating costs.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHENGCHEN POLYTRON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Train safety driving early warning device
abstract_en: The application relates to a train safe driving early warning device, which relates to the technical field of railway transportation safety and comprises a main control unit, a track state detection module, an obstacle recognition module, a weather condition monitoring module, a communication module and a display alarm module, wherein the main control unit is responsible for integral coordination and data processing, the track state detection module comprises a vibration sensor and a displacement sensor which are arranged on a rail, the obstacle recognition module comprises an infrared sensor and a laser radar, the weather condition monitoring module comprises a miniature weather station and a satellite data receiver, the communication module is used for data transmission, the display alarm module is used for real-time display and alarm, the reliability and the accuracy of an early warning system of a train under complex terrain and severe weather conditions are improved through multi-sensor data fusion and AI intelligent analysis, the real-time monitoring and quick response mechanism shortens the emergency response time, the driving safety is ensured, and meanwhile, the real-time communication with a ground control center improves the integral operation efficiency.

title_en: Flood early warning monitoring method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster early warning, and discloses a flood early warning monitoring method based on big data, which comprises the following steps that 1, collecting stations in various places upload data collected by monitoring equipment to a convergence switch through the switch; step 2, the aggregation switch analyzes data and uploads the analyzed data to the Internet; and 3, comparing the data uploaded to the Internet through the main control center. According to the flood early warning and monitoring method based on the big data, the used data resources are fully utilized to collect and summarize, the straight-through data transmission mode of the switch is adopted for data transmission, then the data analysis is carried out by establishing the model through the data mining algorithm, then the data fusion technology is adopted, the analysis can be completed quickly, the data with problems are transmitted to the corresponding switch through the convergence switch after the analysis is completed, a closed loop is formed, and the forecasting precision is increased.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring system based on remote sensing technology and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire monitoring system based on a remote sensing technology and a monitoring method thereof, which relate to the technical field of forest fire monitoring and comprise a ground information acquisition device and a satellite remote sensing monitoring module, wherein the ground information acquisition device acquires information in the ground and the space below a crown in a forest area and sends the information to a control center, the satellite remote sensing monitoring module is used for acquiring remote sensing satellite information on the upper layer of the forest, and the satellite remote sensing monitoring module acquires the information on the upper layer of the forest and then sends the information to the control center, and the forest fire monitoring system further comprises the following specific steps: the forest information acquisition, synchronization to the control center, ground and satellite information fusion and forest real-time data output are realized, environmental signals in the forest and on the upper layer of the forest are acquired through gridding forest ground information acquisition and remote sensing satellite information acquisition, and the fact that a single acquisition point has ground information and remote sensing information can be realized, so that fire can be found in time during forest fire monitoring, and property and forestry resource loss is reduced.
assignees: BEIJING YUANTU TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic intelligent early warning method for shield tunneling induced ground collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dynamic early warning method for ground subsidence induced by shield tunneling. The data acquisition comprises the steps of acquiring engineering geological conditions, hydrogeological conditions, tunnel geometric features, shield construction parameters and other feature factors and ground subsidence data, extracting main features through a random forest model, establishing a model, using multi-factor Taylor series expansion Kalman filtering to fuse the feature factors, optimizing weight coefficients of the feature factors through a differential evolution algorithm, predicting ground subsidence at the next time step by using the model through prediction and early warning, identifying catastrophe singular points according to gradient ratio criteria, and carrying out ground subsidence early warning. The method combines a multisource data fusion technology and a catastrophe theory, is used for solving the problem that ground collapse disasters are difficult to early warn when the shield machine passes through a composite stratum, assists parameter setting and decision of a shield control center, and improves construction safety and efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting full-chain prevention and control system and multi-source information fusion decision-making method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an intelligent fire-fighting full-chain prevention and control system and a multi-source information fusion decision-making method, relates to the technical field of fire fighting, and aims to improve the effective starting rate of an alarm condition processing device of the fire-fighting prevention and control system. The system comprises: the system comprises detection equipment, a fire fighting decision platform, a fire fighting central control platform and alarm situation processing equipment; the fire-fighting decision platform comprises a multi-source information fusion decision module; the detection equipment is connected with the fire-fighting decision-making platform, the multi-source information fusion decision-making module is connected with the fire-fighting central control platform, and the fire-fighting central control platform is connected with the alarm situation processing equipment; the detection equipment detects a fire prevention and control area to obtain first detection information and second detection information, the multi-source information fusion decision module judges whether a fire exists according to the received first detection information and the second detection information, if the fire exists, the multi-source information fusion decision module sends fire information to the fire control center control platform, and the fire control center control platform sends a control signal to control the start of the alarm processing equipment in the fire area. The application is suitable for discovering and processing fire.

title_en: Apparatus and method for emergency dispatch
abstract_en: A disclosed method includes receiving data inputs for a plurality of events including alarms, sensors, and mobile device emergency call and emergency alert related emergency data; determining event correlations based on the data inputs to generate a set of correlated events; determining emergency network dispatch rules for each correlated event based on event type; applying corresponding emergency network dispatch rules to each corresponding correlated event; and sending a dispatch recommendation to an emergency network entity for each correlated event based on application of the corresponding emergency network dispatch rules.

title_en: Intelligent wearable device emergency call system with voiceprint recognition assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wearable device emergency call system assisted by voiceprint recognition, which relates to the technical field of intelligent devices, wherein a multimode data acquisition module is used for acquiring voice information, physiological signals and environment data of a user, a voiceprint recognition and identity verification module is used for extracting voiceprint characteristics of the user, a voiceprint model is built, an emotion state analysis module is used for analyzing the emotion state of the user, and a physiological risk assessment module and an environment risk assessment module are used for respectively assessing the physiological state and the environment of the user in real time. The risk assessment module adopts a multisource data fusion algorithm, comprehensively considers the identity verification result, the emotion state, the physiological state and the environmental factors of the user, and calculates a more accurate comprehensive risk score. The emergency response strategy execution module triggers the emergency response strategy of the corresponding level according to the comparison result of the comprehensive risk score and the preset threshold value, and improves the accuracy of emergency situation identification and the timeliness of response.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted cooperative disaster assessment system
abstract_en: A vehicle-machine cooperative disaster assessment system comprises a mission planning unit, a 2D/3D modeling and picture splicing unit, a data transmission unit, a geographic information data fusion unit, a remote control unit, a system function unit, a multispectral imaging data fusion unit, a target identification and tracking unit, an intelligent analysis unit, a target measurement and analysis unit and a vehicle-machine cooperative system unit; still connect in car machine platform unit, communication system unit, task load unit, patrol and examine robot and unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the method, an external field operator specifies an operation route and operation requirements according to field conditions, an inspection robot finishes driving of a key node of the specified route according to a remote data instruction, an unmanned aerial vehicle automatically takes off according to a command to finish task investigation after the inspection robot reaches the key node, a vehicle or an airplane carries out fine inspection after a suspicious point is found, the whole operation data is returned to a command center in real time, and the command center gives detailed analysis and risk assessment to the suspicious point according to big data.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANGYIDA IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted cooperative disaster assessment system
abstract_en: A vehicle-machine cooperative disaster assessment system comprises a mission planning unit, a 2D/3D modeling and picture splicing unit, a data transmission unit, a geographic information data fusion unit, a remote control unit, a system function unit, a multispectral imaging data fusion unit, a target identification and tracking unit, an intelligent analysis unit, a target measurement and analysis unit and a vehicle-machine cooperative system unit; still connect in car machine platform unit, communication system unit, task load unit, patrol and examine robot and unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the method, field operating personnel specify an operating route and operating requirements according to field conditions, an inspection robot finishes driving of a key node of the specified route according to a remote data instruction, an unmanned aerial vehicle automatically takes off according to an instruction to finish task investigation after the inspection robot reaches the key node, a vehicle or an airplane carries out fine inspection after a suspicious point is found, the whole operating data is transmitted back to a command center in real time, and the command center gives detailed analysis and risk assessment to the suspicious point according to big data.

title_en: Multi-mode data communication method and system using Beidou satellite system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode data communication method and a system using a Beidou satellite system, which relate to the technical field of multi-mode data fusion, wherein the method utilizes an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying sensor and a high-definition camera to collect communication data, environment data and field video data of disaster areas in real time, and the data quality is evaluated by transmitting the data quality index to a command center through a Beidou satellite system, calculating a visual transmission efficiency index scx, an acoustic transmission definition index scz and an environmental interference index hgz, further obtaining a comprehensive transmission quality index czy, and presetting a first data transmission quality threshold A and a second data transmission quality threshold B. The damaged condition and the communication requirement of the disaster area are combined, and the data transmission is prioritized, so that the limited communication resources are optimized, and the stable and reliable communication of the disaster area is ensured. The method overcomes the defect of the traditional communication means when the communication facilities of the disaster area are damaged, and improves the instantaneity, the stability and the resource utilization efficiency of the communication of the disaster area.

title_en: Dynamic task allocation system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic task distribution system based on multi-source data fusion, belongs to the technical field of intelligent task scheduling, and aims to solve the problems of response delay and execution failure caused by indiscriminate rule verification, fuzzy resource matching logic and inaccurate real-time state evaluation in the traditional task distribution system. The system acquires a task request through a task receiving module, converts a plurality of indexes through a data standardization processing module, performs multi-rule verification through a rule matching engine to output matching degree scores, calculates the current capability value of an executor through a real-time capability assessment module, dynamically adjusts double weights according to the emergency degree of the task and generates comprehensive scores, eliminates time, resource and skill conflicts through a conflict detection unit, and finally selects an optimal executor to issue the task through a task distribution unit. The system is suitable for the fields of dispatching orders, emergency response, logistics distribution, maintenance service and the like of the grid command center, which need efficient and accurate task distribution.
assignees: BEIHAI CITY AREA SOCIAL GOVERNMENT GRID GUEHUA COMMAND CENTER;GUANGXI CHENGSHI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic intelligent early warning method for shield tunneling induced ground collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dynamic early warning method for inducing ground collapse by shield tunneling, which comprises the following steps: data acquisition, feature extraction, model establishment and prediction early warning. The data acquisition comprises the steps of acquiring engineering geological conditions, hydrogeological conditions, tunnel geometric characteristics, shield construction parameters and other characteristic factors and ground subsidence data; extracting main features through a random forest model; the model is established, characteristic factors are fused by using multi-factor Taylor series expansion Kalman filtering, and weight coefficients of the characteristic factors are optimized through a differential evolution algorithm; and predicting and early warning the ground subsidence of the next time step by using the model, identifying the catastrophe singular points according to the gradient ratio criterion, and carrying out ground subsidence early warning. The method combines a multisource data fusion technology and a catastrophe theory, is used for solving the problem that ground collapse disasters are difficult to early warn when the shield machine passes through a composite stratum, assists parameter setting and decision of a shield control center, and improves construction safety and efficiency.

title_en: Chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring, which relate to the technical field of emergency response and generate multi-source synchronous data by collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in real time for time alignment, extracting multi-mode characteristics of the multi-source synchronous data for chemical accident identification, retrieving accident scene parameters, carrying out accident response analysis based on an accident identification result, formulating an emergency response scheme and carrying out resource scheduling analysis to construct a resource scheduling network diagram, carrying out accident monitoring early warning signals according to the resource scheduling network diagram in combination with the multi-source synchronous data, generating a real-time decision instruction and pushing the real-time decision instruction and the emergency response scheme to an emergency command center. The method solves the technical problems of low accuracy of identifying the chemical accident and lagged response flow caused by lack of multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and real-time linkage mechanisms in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the identification accuracy of the chemical accident and the emergency response speed.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: System and method for identifying dynamic hidden danger and evaluating risk of special operation site
abstract_en: The application discloses a system and a method for identifying dynamic hidden danger and evaluating risk of a special operation site. The system comprises: the special operation artificial smell detection unit acquires a special operation site gas generation response signal, and the special operation visual detection unit acquires image information and video information of the special operation site; the computing control center receives and gathers a gas generation response signal, image information and video information of a special operation site; the multi-information fusion potential safety hazard identification unit performs scene matching according to the collected response signals of artificial smell and the image video of visual detection, and identifies and marks the potential safety hazard position according to a multi-information fusion algorithm; and the multi-information fusion risk assessment and intelligent early warning unit carries out real-time risk assessment on the risk degree in the operation process according to a risk grading algorithm. The application solves the problems of manual monitoring, lack of safety monitoring information, incomplete identification elements, low detection accuracy, early warning lag and the like in the existing special operation.

title_en: Apparatus and method for emergency dispatch
abstract_en: A disclosed method includes receiving data inputs for a plurality of events including alarms, sensors, and mobile device emergency call and emergency alert related emergency data; determining event correlations based on the data inputs to generate a set of correlated events; determining emergency network dispatch rules for each correlated event based on event type; applying corresponding emergency network dispatch rules to each corresponding correlated event; and sending a dispatch recommendation to an emergency network entity for each correlated event based on application of the corresponding emergency network dispatch rules.

title_en: Self-adaptive disaster site communication and cross-platform data fusion method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data fusion, in particular to a self-adaptive disaster site communication and cross-platform data fusion method and system, which comprises the following steps: s1: the communication network for automatically detecting the field energy comprises a public network, a private network and satellite communication; s2: collecting holographic information of a disaster site; s3: performing preliminary analysis on the data collected in the step S2, and judging the emergency degree and type of the data; s4: adjusting the communication priority to ensure the priority transmission of key information; s5: converting the data with different formats and sources into a unified format; s6: combining data from different platforms, and extracting key information; s7: and feeding the processed key information channel back to the rescue command center. According to the invention, the accuracy and the transmission speed of disaster site information are obviously improved by realizing self-adaptive communication and high-efficiency data fusion, so that the timeliness and the effectiveness of rescue decisions are enhanced.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Fire control three-dimensional visualization and emergency deduction method, device, equipment and medium based on CIM technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire control three-dimensional visualization and emergency deduction method, device, equipment and medium based on CIM technology, and belongs to the technical field of computers.
