The method comprises the steps of obtaining a basic CIM three-dimensional model, fire-fighting exclusive real-time data and building structure basic data, fusing the basic CIM model and the fire-fighting exclusive real-time data through a dynamic fire-fighting attribute mapping algorithm to obtain a fire-fighting CIM model, quantizing the fire-fighting CIM model and the building structure data through a weight algorithm, generating regional fire risk data and visualizing the regional fire risk data through a thermodynamic diagram, obtaining real-time environment and peripheral fire-fighting resource data, performing fire simulation and resource matching, generating an optimization suggestion through a linkage historical case library, obtaining an emergency deduction result, building a multi-view interactive channel, and synchronizing front line marking data and the command center fire-fighting CIM model. According to the technical scheme, fire control data fusion and risk visualization can be achieved, deduction scientificity is improved, and emergency rescue efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI LINBO CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and System for Drone Mission Automation Based on Heterogeneous External Platform Event Integration
title_ko: 이기종 외부 플랫폼 이벤트 연계 기반 드론 임무 자동화 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 시스템

title_en: Multi-mode data communication method and system using Beidou satellite system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode data communication method and a system using a Beidou satellite system, which relate to the technical field of multi-mode data fusion, wherein the method utilizes an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying sensor and a high-definition camera to collect communication data, environment data and field video data of disaster areas in real time, and the data quality is evaluated by transmitting the data quality index to a command center through a Beidou satellite system, calculating a visual transmission efficiency index scx, an acoustic transmission definition index scz and an environmental interference index hgz, further obtaining a comprehensive transmission quality index czy, and presetting a first data transmission quality threshold A and a second data transmission quality threshold B. The damaged condition and the communication requirement of the disaster area are combined, and the data transmission is prioritized, so that the limited communication resources are optimized, and the stable and reliable communication of the disaster area is ensured. The method overcomes the defect of the traditional communication means when the communication facilities of the disaster area are damaged, and improves the instantaneity, the stability and the resource utilization efficiency of the communication of the disaster area.

title_en: Street lamp pole alarm deduplication analysis method and system based on edge cloud collaborative computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a street lamp pole alarm deduplication analysis method and system based on edge cloud collaborative computing; the method comprises the following steps: the edge gateway acquires an analysis request sent by the control center server, and sends the acquired video to the cloud server if the analysis request is continuous frame operation analysis; if the frame is non-continuous frame operation analysis, processing the collected video inside the edge gateway; the edge gateway is arranged inside the street lamp pole; after receiving the video, the cloud server and the edge gateway judge whether the required computing resource exceeds a set threshold value, if not, the video is subjected to structured analysis, and the cloud server feeds back the analysis result to the edge gateway; and the edge gateway judges repeated data according to the structural analysis result, sends alarm information to the control center server according to the judgment result and simultaneously links related equipment.

title_en: Apparatus and method for emergency dispatch
abstract_en: A disclosed method includes receiving data inputs for a plurality of events including alarms, sensors, and mobile device emergency call and emergency alert related emergency data; determining event correlations based on the data inputs to generate a set of correlated events; determining emergency network dispatch rules for each correlated event based on event type; applying corresponding emergency network dispatch rules to each corresponding correlated event; and sending a dispatch recommendation to an emergency network entity for each correlated event based on application of the corresponding emergency network dispatch rules.

title_en: Unmanned intelligent laser inspection system for gas leakage
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned intelligent laser inspection system for gas leakage. The intelligent cruise control system comprises a cruise trolley, six mechanical arms, a laser absorption spectrum intelligent sensing unit, a data remote transmission module and a cloud control center. The cruise trolley and the six-axis mechanical arm obtain accurate positioning and posture reconstruction of the intelligent sensing unit through data fusion and spatial data decoupling. The laser absorption spectrum intelligent sensing unit obtains a laser absorption spectrum signal for judging whether gas is leaked or not, and transmits the spatial information and the leakage amount of the monitoring point to the cloud control center through the data remote transmission module. The invention can detect whether the gas pipeline leaks by using the six-axis mechanical arm to carry the laser absorption spectrum intelligent sensing unit, and can detect the inspection blind spot which is difficult to involve in the leak detection system. Meanwhile, the laser absorption spectrum intelligent sensing units carried by the six-axis mechanical arm and the six-axis mechanical arm are controlled through the cloud control center, detection data are collected, and high-automation intelligent detection is achieved.

title_en: Emergency response and repair method for routing of underwater pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency response and repair method for an underwater pipeline route, which comprises the following steps of S1, firstly placing a detection device into a pipeline along the flowing direction of a fluid medium, S2, starting a measuring instrument of a head mechanism, carrying out data fusion and transmitting the data to a control center of the head mechanism in real time, S3, opening a fan plate, starting a propeller on the head mechanism and a propeller on a propelling mechanism, wherein the two mechanisms work together to realize the swimming and steering movement of the detection device in the pipeline, the sensor is used for detecting the condition in the pipeline, S4, when the head mechanism detects that the flow velocity is suddenly changed in the pipeline, the fan plate is retracted, the propeller and an axial propeller are closed, the descending propeller is started to enable the detection device to be attached to the inner wall of the pipeline, S5, the crawling mechanism drives the detection device to creep, S6, when the flow velocity trend is changed from rising to descending trend, the fixing device is arranged on the inner wall of the pipeline, S7, the repair mechanism works, and S8, the monitoring ring is started. The invention can automatically and efficiently detect and repair the pipeline in an automatic way.

title_en: Fire emergency water supply control system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency water supply control system and a method thereof, which relate to the technical field of fire control and comprise a distributed control network, a control system and a control system, wherein the distributed control network is used for establishing communication connection with a plurality of fire detection devices and a plurality of water supply devices, receiving and processing fire related parameters from various fire detection devices and controlling the operation of the water supply devices; the fire detection equipment is used for continuously collecting fire related parameters; the system comprises a main power supply, a plurality of water supply devices, a standby power supply module and a remote monitoring and control module, wherein the main power supply module is used for supplying power to the system when a main power supply fails, and the remote monitoring and control module is used for carrying out data exchange with a fire control command center and receiving control instructions. The invention realizes accurate judgment and real-time tracking of fire conditions through multi-source information fusion and dynamic analysis, and greatly improves the accuracy and timeliness of system response.

title_en: Intelligent community comprehensive intelligent analysis and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive intelligent analysis and early warning system and method for a smart community, and belongs to the technical field of smart communities. In order to solve the problems of data closure and difficulty in early warning in time, the monitoring camera is installed in each security area, the face recognition module is electrically connected with the behavior analysis module and the AI analysis module, the practical situations that the property management work is difficult to implement and the potential safety hazard is difficult to prevent are solved, by the technical means of high-definition monitoring, face recognition, AI, intellectualization and the like, the potential safety hazard is accurately recognized, the real-time alarm event is accurately handled, the large data query unit gathers all data in the district, the data island of each level of unit information is broken through, data fusion is realized, the fusion analysis module comprehensively analyzes community information by combining monitoring video stream data and all data in the district, based on data, scientific decision making, real-time popup early warning of abnormal conditions and key events are realized, and a command center can check on line, so that online trace management of events and full-process closed-loop management are realized.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG WUTUOBANG CULTURE MEDIA CO LTD

title_en: System for rescuing emergency employing biometric techniques of solid space and hololens
title_ko: 홀로렌즈와 3차원공간에서의 생체인식기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment relates to an emergency patient rescue system using a biometric recognition technology in hololens and three-dimensional space. The emergency patient rescue system comprises: an MR device; and a management information processing device. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing prompt rescue and the like and helping in ensuring a smooth operation in a situation wherein an emergency patient and the like occur.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 홀로렌즈와 3차원공간에서의 생체인식기술을 이용한 응급환자 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로는, 이러한 구조 시스템은 초기 의료대응을 위하여 사용자 주변에 현장의 상황을 의료상황실 등으로 전송하고 응급처치 요원이 의료상황실의 의료지도를 받아 처치를 제공한다. 
구체적으로는, MR 디바이스 측에서 다수의 상이한 사용자별로 설치되어서, 사용자 주변에 현장에서 영상을 촬영하여 홀로렌즈로 투영해서 입체 영상을 수집하여 관리 정보처리장치에 일괄적으로 전달한다. 
그리고, 또한 이러한 경우에 MR 디바이스에서는 입체 영상을 전달할 경우마다, 해당 입체 공간에서의 현장 대상에 대한 생체 객체를 등록 생체 객체와의 비교를 통해 상이한 사용자별로 인식하고, 현장 대상의 실제 객체와 인식한 생체 객체를 정합하여 전달한다. 
이때, MR 디바이스에서는 생체 정보를 입체 공간에서 일실시예의 생체 정보의 인식을 위한 아날로그 클러스터링 인식포맷으로 인식하므로, 생체 정보를 선형적으로 인식하여 원활하게 인식을 한다. 
그러면, 관리 정보처리장치 측에서는 이러한 MR 디바이스에 의해 전달받은 각각의 입체 영상 내 객체와 응급 환자에 관한 설정 이상 객체를 비교하여 응급 환자의 발생 여부를 판별한다. 
그래서, 상기 판별 결과, 응급 환자가 발생한 경우에는 응급 구조정보를 구성하여 내부(또는, 외부 등록 구조 장치)로 알림한다. 반면에 응급 환자가 발생하지 않는 경우에는 알림하지 않으므로, 구조를 수행한다. 
예를 들어, 이러한 경우에, MR 디바이스에서는 상기 관리 정보처리장치로부터 해당 구조 콘텐츠에 따른 구조 정보를 제공받아서, 상기 구조 정보로 상기 MR 디스플레이의 동작을 제어하여 안내한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 실시예에서는 MR 디바이스 등에서 모니터링한 정보를 관리 정보처리장치에 제공할 경우 등에, 사용자 측에서 홀로렌즈를 통한 감시영상을 획득하여 입체적으로 정보분석해서 현장에 있는 특정한 대상의 생체정보를 신속하게 얻는다. 
그리고 나서, 이러한 정보를 원격지의 관리 정보처리장치에 전달하여 응급 조치를 즉시 받을 수 있도록 함으로써, 응급 환자 등이 발생한 상황에서 신속하게 구조 등을 제공하고 원활하게 할 수 있도록 도움을 준다.

title_en: Operating system for automatic defibrillator and operating method therefor
title_ko: 신속 응급처치를 위한 자동제세동기의 운용 시스템 및 그 운용 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic defibrillator operating system for quick first aid and an operating method thereof are provided to enable a first aid man to quickly find a near automatic defibrillator through an AR(Augmented Reality) image displayed on a mobile communication terminal based on the location of an emergency patient. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of automatic defibrillator operating units(140) transmit a video file of a first aid site situation to a server. A database server(120) stores location information of the automatic defibrillator operating units. An automatic defibrillator-integrated operation server(110) transmits a remote control signal. A mobile communication terminal(130) matches the location information of the automatic defibrillator operating units with actual images. abstract_ko: 본 발명은 일반 응급처치자가 응급환자의 발생 위치를 기준으로 이동통신 단말기에 표시되는 증강현실 화면을 통해 인접한 자동제세동기를 신속히 찾은 후, 통합상황실에서 전송되는 동영상과 관리자 음성을 통해 자동제세동기를 올바르게 작동시키면서 응급처치를 할 수 있도록 하는 신속 응급처치를 위한 자동제세동기의 운용 시스템 및 그 운용 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 신속 응급조치를 위한 자동제세동기의 운용 시스템은, 자동제세동기, 상기 자동제세동기의 응급처치 장면을 촬영하는 현장카메라, 상기 자동제세동기의 사용법 및 응급처치 요령 안내를 위한 디스플레이부 및 스피커, 응급처치 현장의 음성 획득을 위한 마이크, 상기 현장카메라, 디스플레이부, 스피커, 마이크의 작동 제어 및 전체적인 제어 기능을 하는 제어부, 상기 자동제세동기를 수납하는 도어 장착형 보관함, 상기 보관함에서 상기 자동제세동기가 인출되는지 여부를 감지 후 자동제세동기 인출시 해당 신호를 상기 제어부에 입력하는 자동제세동기 탈착 감지센서를 포함하고, 상기 현장카메라에서 촬영되는 응급처치 현장의 상황을 동영상 파일로 서버에 전송하며, 여러 지역에 분산되어 설치되는 복수의 자동제세동기 운용부와, 상기 자동제세동기 운용부의 위치정보가 저장되는 데이서베이스 서버와, 상기 복수의 자동제세동기 운용부가 유무선 인터넷망을 통해 접속되고, 상기 자동제세동기의 작동 설명을 위한 영상 매뉴얼 정보 및 마이크를 구비하며, 상기 데이터베이스 서버로부터 상기 자동제세동기 운용부의 위치정보를 검출한 후 이를 이동통신망을 통해 이동통신 단말기에 출력하는 동시에, 자동제세동기 운용부의 상기 현장카메라, 디스플레이부, 스피커, 마이크 작동을 위한 원격제어신호를 상기 유무선 인터넷망을 통해 전송하는 자동제세동기 통합운영서버와, 자동제세동기의 위치 확인을 위한 증강현실 어플리케이션이 저장되고, 카메라가 장착되며, 상기 증강현실 어플리케이션의 실행 후 상기 카메라로 일정 영역을 비추면 자체 기능에 의해 획득한 현재 위치정보를 이동통신망을 통해 상기 통합운영서버에 전송하고, 상기 이동통신망을 통해 전송되는 자동제세동기의 위치정보를 수신 후 이를 상기 카메라에 의해 비춰지는 실사 영상에 정합하여 증강현실 화면으로 출력하는 이동통신 단말기를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Intelligent management and service platform for expressway
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management and service platform for a highway, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent service platforms for the highway and comprises a control center, wherein the control center is in communication connection with a data transmission module, the data transmission module is respectively in communication connection with an emergency command system, a charging operation analysis system, an electromechanical maintenance system, a member management system and a safety supervision system, the data transmission module is electrically connected with a data temporary storage module, the data temporary storage module is in communication connection with the control center, and the control center is in communication connection with a cloud database. The intelligent management and service platform for the expressway can integrate and cooperatively manage various basic data of the expressway, achieves the management targets of dynamic perception, data fusion, multiple service and high decision efficiency, and comprehensively improves the intelligent level of expressway operation management and information service.
assignees: HEBEI JIAOTOU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;HEBEI EXPRESSWAY DEV GROUP CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;UNIV HEBEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Emergency linkage control system for monitoring fire hazard of oil depot in real time
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency linkage control system for monitoring fire hazards of an oil depot in real time, which relates to the technical field of safety monitoring and comprises an emergency linkage control center, wherein the emergency linkage control center is in communication connection with a multi-source data fusion sensing module, and the multi-source data fusion sensing module is used for constructing a multi-mode sensor network, collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in real time, and carrying out fusion analysis to generate a dynamic distribution map of the hazards. According to the invention, a multi-mode sensor network is constructed, various sensors are integrated to realize real-time high-frequency acquisition of oil depot environment, equipment and disaster evolution data, a space-time data fusion engine is combined, data noise is eliminated, a hidden danger dynamic distribution map is generated, so that monitoring data covers the whole area of the oil depot, the time resolution reaches the second level, compared with a traditional threshold triggering mode, the system can dynamically capture multi-source heterogeneous data of key areas of the oil depot, discover hidden danger evolution trend in advance, the disaster early warning time is shortened, and the active inhibition capability is remarkably improved.

title_en: Chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring, which relate to the technical field of emergency response and generate multi-source synchronous data by collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in real time for time alignment, extracting multi-mode characteristics of the multi-source synchronous data for chemical accident identification, retrieving accident scene parameters, carrying out accident response analysis based on an accident identification result, formulating an emergency response scheme and carrying out resource scheduling analysis to construct a resource scheduling network diagram, carrying out accident monitoring early warning signals according to the resource scheduling network diagram in combination with the multi-source synchronous data, generating a real-time decision instruction and pushing the real-time decision instruction and the emergency response scheme to an emergency command center. The method solves the technical problems of low accuracy of identifying the chemical accident and lagged response flow caused by lack of multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and real-time linkage mechanisms in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the identification accuracy of the chemical accident and the emergency response speed.
